guard.firstDraft: Chaliye, ab isi observation ko agle object par apply kijiye. Paani ke glass ke andar neeche ek paper clip padi hai. Guess kariye: kya bahar se tez magnet ghuma kar, paani ko chhuiye-e bina, clip ko glass ki deewar ke saath upar la sakte ho?

turns.childText: ek minute ruko, bathroom jaana hai
turns.teacherReply: Theek hai, Ishaan—break lijiye. Wapas aakar hum isi magnetic experiment ko ek-ek step mein continue karenge.

move.shape: they asked for a short break: agree warmly; the lesson waits right here for them; one line for when they are back; no question now; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

move.shape: two parts — first: they are back after a moment away: welcome them back in two or three words, no goodbye and no fuss; carry on; second: the question on the card, as written, in their language; then wait; no verdict on their reply: neither praise nor 'wrong'; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu
